verdict.rationale: Consensus supports large-scale operations like importing thousands of papers in one click, running automated searches via its API, and Deep Searches across many studies, which map to bulk-operation needs for AI-native users. However, there is no documented batch/bulk API endpoint, rate limits, or explicit multi-item automation examples (e.g., processing hundreds of papers programmatically in one call) — missing for 10: explicit bulk API endpoint documentation, batch processing limits/examples, and independent confirmation of large-scale automation performance.
